About

Branding, campaigns and events

I am a BBA Marketing student at Islamic University, Bangladesh.

My work sits where branding, campaigns and event operations meet. I have led branding and promotion for a student business club, built campaign strategies for clients, and organised a conference with delegates from 30 institutions.

I coordinate large teams, manage brand partnerships and run business events. In practice that means shaping how an organisation looks and sounds, guiding volunteers, securing sponsors, and getting a campaign in front of the right audience. Running an online store and a sales stall gave me a direct view of how customers respond.

Model United Nations built my interest in international finance, trade and commerce, and the Sustainable Development Goals.
